name: Wavestrider Beach
summary: Burning ships still clash offshore from Wavestrider Beach on Tanaris's eastern coast. The shore stretches between Steamwheedle Port and Lost Rigger Cove, where crustaceans roam the sand and pirates command the nearby waters.

sections.title: A Treacherous Coastline
sections.body: Steeljaw Snappers and Desert Crawlers scuttle over the baking sand. Wavestrider Beach follows eastern Tanaris from Steamwheedle Port in the north to the cliffs above Lost Rigger Cove. Offshore, burning vessels remain locked in combat. Their flames mark the violence that grips these pirate waters.

faq.answer: Wavestrider Beach follows Tanaris's eastern coast, from Steamwheedle Port in the north to Lost Rigger Cove in the south.

faq.q: What creatures wander the sands here?
faq.answer: Desert Crawlers and Steeljaw Snappers roam the sand and surf.

faq.q: What are the burning ships visible offshore?
faq.answer: Two blazing vessels remain locked in combat offshore, reflecting the pirate activity around the Southsea Freebooters' hideouts.

faq.q: Is Wavestrider Beach safe to travel through?
faq.answer: The shore is hazardous, with aggressive crabs and snapjaws by the water and Southsea pirates nearby. Unwary travelers can quickly be overwhelmed.
